tasks.label: Extract CVS data
args: $indexPath='www/index.html'; $cvsPath='www/assets/js/data/cvs.js'; $lines=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($indexPath); $start=[Array]::IndexOf($lines,'    // --- CVS Questions with Subcategories ---'); $end=[Array]::IndexOf($lines,'    // --- GIT Questions with Subcategories ---'); if($start -lt 0 -or $end -le $start){throw 'CVS boundaries not found'}; $cvsLines=@('const CVS_QUESTIONS = [') + $lines[($start+1)..($end-1)] + @('];','','window.CVS_QUESTIONS = CVS_QUESTIONS;'); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($cvsPath,$cvsLines,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $remaining=@(); if($start -gt 0){$remaining += $lines[0..($start-1)]}; $remaining += $lines[$end..($lines.Length-1)]; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($indexPath,$remaining,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
